blk_scene_enfants_rouges.text: You are at a prepared-food counter inside Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris's oldest covered food market. Around you, cooks serve dishes from several cultures. A rice-and-vegetable dish looks good, but you have a nut allergy. First ask, “What is in this?” Then ask, “Does this contain nuts?” and say, “I am allergic to nuts.” If the dish is unsafe, point to a sealed bottle of water and say, “One of these, please.”
